name: review
description: Code review for completed implementation work: ordinary and adversarial reviewer-critic review, plus a code-shape pass, run by dedicated review-only agents.

code_reviewer_model.title: Code reviewer model
code_reviewer_model.description: Model alias the code reviewer agent runs on. The ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL environment variables choose what each alias resolves to.

code_reviewer_effort.title: Code reviewer effort
code_reviewer_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the code reviewer agent. A model that lacks a level runs at the highest one it supports below it.
